risk_summary: The disclosure is highly technical and generally well quantified, including impairment charges, valuation assumptions, discount-rate ranges, and segment margins. Risk is elevated by substantial prior-year goodwill and long-lived asset impairments and reliance on forecasts, terminal growth, and macroeconomic recovery assumptions, although management characterizes current impairment indicators as absent.
